escena: SCENE (cinematic top-down photograph, a dark workshop desk at night): two hands (no face) lay down the last glowing piece of a user interface that is being built on top of a technical blueprint drawn in fine white lines on a dark navy sheet: rectangles, cards and buttons made of thin white and soft cyan light snap together like construction blocks, half of the interface still a wireframe, half already alive and glowing. A metal ruler and a pencil lie beside the sheet. Monochrome navy and white with only a small touch of cyan light; dramatic overhead light, deep shadows, real paper texture. COMPOSITION FOR A CIRCULAR CROP: everything important stays inside the central circle of the square; the four corners are only dark empty space.  Rich contrast, punchy saturated colour, real photographic detail and texture (dust, micro-scratches, real depth of field), no text, no readable letters or numbers, no logos of any other brand.
